fun_facts: Will Anderson Jr. is from Hampton, Georgia; as a high-school senior, he recorded 22 sacks and 15 tackles for loss.
In 2021, Will Anderson Jr. led the FBS with 17.5 sacks.
Will Anderson Jr. became Alabama’s first two-time unanimous All-American.
During his final college awards week, Will Anderson Jr. won four trophies: the Lott IMPACT, Nagurski, Lombardi and Bednarik awards.
Will Anderson Jr. won NFL Defensive Rookie of the Year. That same season, teammate C.J. Stroud won Offensive Rookie of the Year, making them the fourth teammates in league history to win both awards.

### What kind of prospect was Will Anderson Jr. in high school?

Anderson was a five-star defensive end at Duchtown high school in Hampton, Ga. Anderson ranked as high as the fifth-best player in the country, the top player in Georgia and the top weakside defensive end in the class of 2020. Anderson finished his senior season with 22 sacks and 15 tackles for loss, earning First-Team All-State honors from the Atlanta Journal-Constitution.
